tasks.description: Choose a payment provider and set up an account. Research popular payment providers such as Stripe, PayPal, and Square. Consider factors such as fees, security, and ease of integration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment provider, when a payment is made, then the payment is successfully processed

tasks.description: Determine which currencies to support and implement currency conversion. Consider factors such as exchange rates, fees, and localization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a currency, when a payment is made, then the payment is converted to the correct currency

tasks.description: Define plan tiers and their prices. Consider factors such as pricing strategy, competition, and revenue goals.
acceptance_criteria: Given a plan tier, when a payment is made, then the correct plan tier is assigned to the user

tasks.description: Research and implement tax handling for payments. Consider factors such as tax rates, exemptions, and compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment, when tax is applied, then the correct tax amount is calculated

tasks.description: Create a refund policy and implement it in the payment system. Consider factors such as refund timelines, amounts, and conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund request, when the refund is processed, then the correct refund amount is returned to the user

tasks.description: Design and implement a user interface for making payments. Consider factors such as usability, security, and accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment UI, when a user makes a payment, then the payment is successfully processed and the user is notified

tasks.description: Integrate the payment system with the user account system. Consider factors such as account linking, payment history, and subscription management.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment, when the payment is tied to a user account, then the payment is successfully linked to the account

tasks.description: Implement logic to activate a user's subscription after a successful payment. Consider factors such as subscription status, payment confirmation, and account updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment, when the payment is successful, then the user's subscription is activated
